title: Medelco RK202 One All Universal Single-Cup Replacement Coffee Filter
text: Medelco RK202 One All Universal Single-Cup Replacement Coffee Filter. ok, to be honest. I haven't used mine yet. I bought it with intentions of using it but I just haven't. I'm not sorry I purchased it and do plan on making use of it soon. It appears to be a good alternative to purchasing the disposable Kcups.
